metadata.description:
I was subbing for someone on this episode.

Side A

  • One On One… Nas
  • Intro Airbreak
  • Green Island… Redman
  • Sittin’ In My Car… Slick Rick
  • Russian Roulette… Courageous Chief
  • Gotta Get Up… Black Sheep
  • Dial “M” for Murder… Malik
  • Roll Wit Tha Flava (Kid Capri Bounce Track)… The Flavor Unit MC’s
  • Maniac… Parental Advisory
  • Carry the Way (Along Time) (feat. Saafir)… Digital Underground
  • Airbreak
  • Ruffian… Charlie Chaplin
  • Boom Bye Bye… Buju Banton

Side B

  • Boom Bye Bye… Buju Banton (cont.)
  • Charge Fi Murder… Ninja Man, Snow & Junior Reid
  • It’s A Just Ice Thing… Just-Ice
  • Terrifying Tracks… KMC
  • Wake the Dead… Esham
  • Airbreak
  • Malcolm… Umar Bin Hassan
  • Smokin’ That S*#% (feat. Kurious, Earth Quake, & Lord Sear)… KMD
  • Pandemonium… The Pharcyde
  • Pimps (Free Stylin’ at the Fortune 500 Club)… The Coup
  • Worship the “D”… Saafir
  • Airbreak
  • Maximum Power Surge… Reign of Terror

Side C

  • Maximum Power Surge… Reign of Terror (cont.)
  • Honeydips in Gotham… Boogiemonsters
  • Brown Sugar… Extra Prolific
  • Mr. Sandman (feat. Rza)… Method Man
  • Airbreak
  • Gucci Time… Schoolly D
